theorems.name: Submission.radon_exists_measure_of_tendsto_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : ℕ → Measure X), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ j K ≤ C) → (∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μ j)) atTop (𝓝 L)) → ∃ ν : Measure X, IsLocallyFiniteMeasure ν ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μ j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
